Here are a couple of in-stock starter picks:

Absolutely! If you’re looking to keep costs down while you learn, here are some great options to consider:

Best budget starter: Wax Melt Discovery Kit — $25.00

Why it’s a good first pick:



It’s the lowest-cost intro option I found.


You get 9 best-selling scents, so you can figure out which fragrance types you actually like before buying more.


It’s described as a low-commitment way to get started.




Best budget warmer: Timer Outlet Wall Plug-In Wax Warmer — $24.95

Why it’s beginner-friendly:



It’s one of the least expensive warmers available.


It has a 3-6-9 hour integrated timer.


It includes a "No-Scrape" silicone wax melt dish.


The plug-in style is great if you want something simple for a bathroom or kitchen.




Best simple tabletop warmer: Mini Mod Wax Warmer — $29.95

Why you might choose this instead:



Still relatively affordable.


Has a built-in ceramic heater.


Includes 3-6-9 hour auto shut-off.


Also has the "No-Scrape" wax melt removal dish.




If you want an all-in-one kit: Wax Melt Discovery Starter Kit — $44.95

Why it may still be worth it:



Includes 1 warmer + 9 best-selling scents.


Easiest setup if you don’t want to piece things together.


But it does cost more upfront than starting with a warmer or scents alone.




My honest recommendation

If you’re trying not to overpay while learning, I’d suggest:



Wax Melt Discovery Kit if you want the cheapest way to explore scents first.


Timer Outlet Wall Plug-In Wax Warmer if you need an affordable warmer.


Mini Mod Wax Warmer if you want a small standalone warmer with a bit more flexibility.
